description: SCOUT's building rasterizer, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Rasterize Buildings node runs SCOUT's convert_raster on a buildings layer and saves the zoom-16 height tiles it writes, the input of SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model, as the dataflow's computed dataset "tiles"; Mosaic Tiles joins them into one raster in metres that an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Raster Conversion

templates.description: SCOUT's OSM vector to raster: SCOUT's convert_raster draws each building's height into 256 by 256 map tiles at a zoom level, 8-bit gray where 255 is the maximum height, in EPSG:3395. Input: a buildings GeoDataFrame with a column of heights in metres. Output: the tiles, saved as one of this dataflow's computed datasets under the name the "Save tiles as" widget gives ("tiles"), and a DATAFRAME of them (zoom, x, y, max_height) for Mosaic Tiles.
templates.label: Rasterize Buildings

templates.description: The tiles Rasterize Buildings saved, side by side in one raster. Input: Rasterize Buildings' DATAFRAME of tiles (zoom, x, y, max_height); the tiles are read from the computed dataset of this dataflow the "Tiles" widget names, as Rasterize Buildings saved them ("tiles"). Output: one RASTER in EPSG:3395, heights in metres, for an Autark map and for Accumulated Shadow (scout.shadow).
templates.label: Mosaic Tiles
